aboutUs.title: Meet our team
aboutUs.description: At MDK Studio, our team of developers is at the heart of what we do. We are dedicated and passionate about creating innovative solutions that turn ideas into reality.

questions.question: How much does it cost to build a website?
questions.answer: The cost depends on several factors, including the project's complexity, number of pages, and specific features required. We offer personalized quotes based on your needs and requirements.

questions.question: How can I update my website content after it's finished?
questions.answer: We provide basic training so you can manage and modify texts, images, and other site elements. If you prefer, we can also handle updates for you as needed.

questions.question: Can MDK Studio help me choose a domain name?
questions.answer: Yes, we can help you choose a domain name. We consider factors such as relevance to your business, ease of memorization, and availability. We offer guidance and suggestions to find a name that fits your brand identity and is available for registration.

questions.question: How long does it take to complete my website?
questions.answer: The timeline may vary depending on the project's complexity, but generally, a simple website takes 2 to 3 weeks to develop. More complex projects, such as web applications or advanced functionality, may take longer.

questions.question: Does MDK Studio offer technical support after the website is launched?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer technical support after the website is launched. This includes bug fixes, security updates, necessary adjustments, and guidance on managing content. We're here to ensure your website continues to run smoothly and meets your needs.

questions.question: Does MDK Studio provide hosting services?
questions.answer: We offer recommendations for hosting services and can help set up the hosting environment, but we do not provide hosting services directly.

questions.question: How can I get in touch to request a quote or consultation?
questions.answer: You can contact us through the form on our website, via email, or by phone. We're available to discuss your needs and provide a personalized quote.

privacy.pageTitle: Privacy Policy — Enigma Case | MDK Studio
privacy.metaDescription: Read the privacy policy for Enigma Case, developed by MDK Studio. Understand how your data is handled in the app available on the Google Play Store.
privacy.keywords: privacy policy, enigma case, privacy, mdk studio, personal data
privacy.quickSummaryText: Enigma Case is an offline game that does not collect personal data. All progress is saved locally on your device. No account, no server, no tracking.

items.subtitle: Data we do NOT collect
items.text: Enigma Case is an offline game. We do not collect names, emails, phone numbers, location, or any personally identifiable information.

items.subtitle: Game progress (local storage)
items.text: Progress data, such as unlocked cases, achievements, and settings, is saved exclusively in your device's local storage using AsyncStorage/MMKV. This data never leaves your device.

items.subtitle: Game functionality
items.text: Locally saved data is used solely to maintain your progress between sessions, exactly as you would expect from any game.

items.subtitle: Quality improvements
items.text: Anonymous crash reports help us identify and fix bugs, ensuring a better experience for all players.

items.subtitle: We do not sell your data
items.text: We never sell, rent, or commercialize user information with third parties for advertising or any other purpose.

items.subtitle: Infrastructure third parties
items.text: We may use services such as Expo Application Services (EAS) for distribution and technical analysis. These services follow their own privacy policies and only handle aggregated technical data.

items.subtitle: Local data protected by the OS
items.text: Since all data stays on your device, it is protected by Android's native safeguards (app sandbox, disk encryption when enabled by the device).

items.subtitle: No personal data transmission
items.text: Because we do not transmit personal data to external servers, the risk of a personal data breach is inherently minimal.

items.subtitle: Data deletion
items.text: To delete all game data, simply uninstall the app from your device. All local data will be automatically removed by the operating system.

items.subtitle: No account required
items.text: Enigma Case does not require account creation. You can play completely anonymously.

items.subtitle: Children
items.text: The app is rated for ages 10 and up, as indicated on the Google Play Store. We do not intentionally collect data from children.

items.subtitle: Change notifications
items.text: If this policy is materially updated, we will publish the new version on this page with an updated effective date. We recommend reviewing it periodically.

items.subtitle: Continued use
items.text: Continued use of the app after changes are published constitutes acceptance of those changes.

items.subtitle: Questions or requests
items.text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise any rights related to personal data, please contact us at:

mathtrailPrivacy.metaDescription: Read the privacy policy for MathTrail, developed by MDK Studio. Understand how your math learning and progress data are protected and handled.
mathtrailPrivacy.keywords: privacy policy, mathtrail, mathematics, mdk studio, app privacy, gdpr, google play
mathtrailPrivacy.quickSummaryText: MathTrail is an educational app for learning mathematics. We prioritize your privacy: we do not display third-party ads, we do not sell your data, and you can use the app completely anonymously. Progress data can be securely synced to the cloud if you choose to sign in with your Google account.

items.subtitle: Account & Optional Authentication
items.text: You can use MathTrail anonymously (guest mode) or connect your Google Account via Supabase Auth. When you sign in, we only receive basic identifiers provided by Google (such as your user ID, public name, and email) to authenticate and sync your progress across devices.

items.subtitle: Learning Progress & Study Data
items.text: To enable learning trails and lesson mechanics, we record your answered exercises history, scores, study time, daily streaks, unlocked lessons, and achievements. This data is saved locally on your device (Room Database and DataStore) and, if signed in, synchronized with our secure cloud database (Supabase).

items.subtitle: Profile & Leaderboard Location
items.text: You may customize a nickname and manually select your State and Country for public leaderboard rankings. MathTrail does NOT access GPS sensors and does NOT track your real-time geographical location.

items.subtitle: Pedagogical Experience & Gamification
items.text: We use your study data to calculate your active streaks, recommend quick reviews for topics with lower accuracy, award achievements, and update your position on leaderboards.

items.subtitle: Cloud Sync & Backup
items.text: For authenticated users, cloud synchronization allows you to restore your progress if you switch devices or reinstall the app.

items.subtitle: Diagnostics & Quality
items.text: We use aggregated technical data to monitor app stability, resolve crashes, and optimize screen responsiveness.

items.subtitle: Google Firebase
items.text: We use Firebase Crashlytics to receive anonymous crash reports, Firebase Performance & Analytics for aggregated performance telemetry, and Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) to deliver study notifications and streak reminders.

items.subtitle: Supabase Cloud
items.text: Our cloud database and authentication provider with strict security controls, encryption in transit and at rest.

items.subtitle: Google Play Services
items.text: We utilize official Google Play APIs for core services, such as Google Sign-In and Google Play In-App Reviews.

items.subtitle: No Third-Party Ads
items.text: MathTrail was designed with a pure focus on the learning experience. The app does NOT contain any third-party ad networks (such as AdMob or targeted ads).

items.subtitle: We Do Not Sell Your Data
items.text: We never sell, rent, lease, or share personal information with third parties or data brokers.

items.subtitle: Encryption & Operating System Protection
items.text: All communication with our cloud servers is protected by TLS/HTTPS encryption. Data stored locally on your device is protected by the native Android app sandbox.

items.subtitle: Data Retention
items.text: Progress data for authenticated users is retained as long as the account remains active. For guest mode users, data exists exclusively in the device's local storage.

items.subtitle: Access, Rectification & Deletion
items.text: You have the right to access, rectify, or request the permanent deletion of your account and all associated data at any time.

items.subtitle: How to Delete Your Data
items.text: To delete local data, simply clear app storage in Android settings or uninstall the app. To request the complete deletion of your synchronized cloud account and student profile, please email us at contato@mdkstudio.com.br.

items.subtitle: Notification Preferences
items.text: You can enable or disable study reminder notifications at any time in your Android device settings.

items.subtitle: Safe Environment for Learners
items.text: MathTrail is an educational app created for mathematics learning. We do not collect unnecessary data, do not perform invasive behavioral tracking, and do not commercialize student data.

items.subtitle: Periodic Revisions
items.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect app improvements or legal compliance requirements. Any significant changes will be published on this page with an updated revision date.

items.subtitle: Reach Out to MDK Studio
items.text: If you have questions, feedback, or requests regarding your privacy and data protection in MathTrail, please contact us at:

mathtrailDeleteAccount.pageTitle: Account & Data Deletion — MathTrail | MDK Studio
mathtrailDeleteAccount.metaDescription: Learn how to request the deletion of your account and all associated personal and progress data for MathTrail, developed by MDK Studio.
mathtrailDeleteAccount.keywords: delete account, account deletion, mathtrail, mdk studio, privacy, gdpr, google play
mathtrailDeleteAccount.heroSubtitle: Guidelines and steps for requesting permanent deletion of your account and data for the MathTrail app, developed by MDK Studio.
mathtrailDeleteAccount.summaryText: In MathTrail, you have full control over your personal data. Whether you used the app with a signed-in Google account or in anonymous/guest mode, you can request or perform the complete deletion of your data at any time.
mathtrailDeleteAccount.stepsSubtitle: Follow the steps below according to your needs:
mathtrailDeleteAccount.step1Desc: If you use MathTrail in guest mode or simply wish to remove local data from your Android device:
step1Items: Tap 'Clear Data' / 'Clear Storage', or simply uninstall the app.
All locally saved progress in the Room database and preferences will be erased immediately.
mathtrailDeleteAccount.step2Desc: If you linked a Google Account for progress synchronization and wish to permanently delete your account from our cloud servers (Supabase):
step2Items: Send an email to contato@mdkstudio.com.br with the subject: 'Account Deletion Request - MathTrail'.
In the body of the email, provide the email address associated with your Google Account used in the app and, optionally, your username.
Our team will process the request and confirm the permanent deletion via email.
